orgVariable.name: org_name
orgVariable.description: NGC organization name (the org id shown in the NGC console under Organization -> Setup, e.g. 0123456789ab). Resolved from the NGC_ORG environment variable when it is set (x-stackQL-envVar - the same variable the NVIDIA Terraform provider reads); otherwise it must be supplied on every org-scoped query as WHERE org_name = '<org>'. A WHERE value always takes precedence over the environment.
